description: Upload an already-built, already-signed .ipa to App Store Connect via `xcrun altool --upload-app` — for binaries produced elsewhere (eas build, a CI artifact, a manual Xcode archive/export). No fastlane, no local archive step; just the ASC API key already configured for this server. Runs asynchronously — returns a job ID immediately; poll with asc_job_status. After success, watch asc_list_builds for processingState VALID.

ipa_path.description: Path to the signed .ipa file to upload

name: asc_upload_ipa
